title: T1598.001 — Phishing for Information - Spearphishing Service
subtitle: The animation replays a typical attack in eight steps.
aria: Animated simulation of spearphishing through a third-party service. An attacker builds a fake recruiter profile on a social platform, chats with a target, collects internal details, and the SOC responds in eight steps.

nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.tip: The threat actor hiding behind a fake recruiter or support profile.

nodes.label: LinkedIn / X
nodes.tip: The public platform the attacker abuses. Your logs here are limited.

nodes.label: Employee
nodes.tip: The employee whose profile and answers the attacker wants.

nodes.label: Personal Email
nodes.tip: The attacker often moves the talk to personal email, away from company eyes.

nodes.label: Intel Notes
nodes.tip: Facts collected from chats: team names, tools, schedules, badge rules.

nodes.label: SOC / Defender
nodes.tip: Your security team. They rely on user reports and platform takedowns.

steps.title: Build persona
steps.caption: The attacker creates a believable recruiter profile with a stock photo, fake history, and a few followers.
steps.defender: The persona lives on a third-party service you do not control.

detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Study target
steps.caption: The attacker studies the target's public profile: role, projects, connections, and work habits.
steps.defender: Public profile data shapes the story. Limit what is public about staff.

fields.detail: The attacker studies the target's public profile: role, projects, connections, and work habits.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Connect
steps.caption: A connection request arrives. It looks like a normal career opportunity, so the target accepts.
steps.defender: Unexpected invites with no shared history deserve a second look.

fields.detail: A connection request arrives. It looks like a normal career opportunity, so the target accepts.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Build trust
steps.caption: Days or weeks of friendly chat follow: job talk, salary, challenges. The persona feels real.
steps.defender: Third-party platforms share little telemetry. User reporting is your main sensor.

fields.detail: Days or weeks of friendly chat follow: job talk, salary, challenges. The persona feels real.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Ask details
steps.caption: The persona asks about teams, tools, badge rules, or an upcoming project. Each answer is a small gift.
steps.defender: Questions about internal systems are a red flag, not curiosity.

fields.detail: The persona asks about teams, tools, badge rules, or an upcoming project. Each answer is a small gif

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Target replies
steps.caption: The target answers. Org charts, tool names, and schedules flow out through the platform.
steps.defender: Screenshots and personal-email uploads can leak data. Watch both.

fields.detail: The target answers. Org charts, tool names, and schedules flow out through the platform.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Move channels
steps.caption: The attacker moves the talk to personal email or a form, away from platform moderation.
steps.defender: Work devices talking to personal mail is a policy violation. Alert on it.

fields.detail: The attacker moves the talk to personal email or a form, away from platform moderation.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Report and warn
steps.caption: The user reports the persona. The SOC warns others, updates training, and files a platform takedown.
steps.defender: Preserve the DMs as evidence. Report the account to the platform quickly.

fields.detail: The user reports the persona. The SOC warns others, updates training, and files a platform takedown.

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
